dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Hello there! You're here for a game of cards, if I'm not mistaken? Don't worry, I won't call on the Anemo Archon for help with my draws. The windows here are tightly shut, after all. Not even the slightest breeze could get in.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Leaving? Well, it's about time I made a move, too. It's a little stuffy in here... Think I could do with some fresh air. Besides, without a breeze to carry their messages, how else would a certain someone track me down?

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Victory. Hmm... Next time I'm building a deck, I'll be sure to leave a window or two open so that the Anemo Archon can help me "shuffle" things up. Thanks be to Barbatos...

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Impressive. If there was a Card Archon out there, you'd surely be his sole herald.

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: A game of cards? Of course! Who knows, we might even have the fortune to overhear some of our fellow patrons' troubles while we're at it. May the Anemo Archon bless their draws.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Haha, looks like I've won. A fruitful duel, I'd say.

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Oh dear, I lost? Guess that's the price for letting myself get distracted.

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: You want an all-out duel? Sure, that should liven things up. Considering your skills, this should be an interesting game...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Phew... That was close. You sure are a tough one.

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Not bad. Those were some interesting plays... Nice one, partner. Always helping me discover something new, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
